_comment: Cross-runtime oracle for the BTC-native -> USD return conversion (Phase 164.6.6.2 D-18, D-22, D-23). Read by src/lib/factsheet/native-to-usd.test.ts and by the Python twin built in plan 164.6.6.2-13. Every `expected` value is a HAND-COMPUTED literal (see each `arithmetic`), never produced by either implementation. usd_k = (1 + r_k) * (1 + btc_k) - 1, where r_k is the account's BTC-denominated daily return and btc_k the BTC close-to-close move over the same interval. A `null` series value stands for a non-finite number (JSON has no NaN).

cases.name: missing_close_gap_drops_both_adjacent_days
cases.arithmetic: No close on 2026-02-04. Day 2026-02-03 is fully priced: 1.5 x (110 / 100) - 1 = 1.65 - 1 = 0.65. 2026-02-04 has no close, and 2026-02-05's interval starts at the missing close, so both are absent (never 0, never bridged).

cases.name: dropped_close_is_never_bridged
cases.arithmetic: The 2026-02-03 close is corrupt (dropped). 2026-02-03 has no close; 2026-02-04's interval spans the dropped date and is not bridged. 2026-02-05: BTC 133.1 / 121 - 1 = 0.10, r = 0.10, so 1.1 x 1.1 - 1 = 0.21.

cases.name: days_after_last_close_are_absent
cases.arithmetic: The last close is 2026-02-03: 1.5 x (110 / 100) - 1 = 0.65. Later days have no close, so they are absent, not carried forward.

cases.name: null_unit_returns_series_unchanged
cases.arithmetic: A USD row (unit null) is already USD: the series is returned as it came, day 0 included, whatever closes are supplied.

cases.name: unit_without_closes_returns_empty
cases.arithmetic: A native unit with no price source cannot be converted; nothing is invented, so the output is empty.

cases.name: empty_series_returns_empty
cases.arithmetic: No input days, no output days.

cases.name: one_point_series_returns_empty
cases.arithmetic: Only day 0 exists, and day 0 has no prior priced USD value, so it yields no USD return.

cases.name: non_finite_input_day_is_absent
cases.arithmetic: 2026-02-03's account return is non-finite, so that day is absent. 2026-02-04: BTC 121 / 110 - 1 = 0.10, so 1.5 x 1.1 - 1 = 0.65.

cases.name: weekend_gap_with_missing_sunday_close_is_absent
cases.arithmetic: Fri 2026-01-02 to Mon 2026-01-05 spans three BTC days but Sunday 2026-01-04 has no close. A seven-day calendar is not fully covered, so the interval is unpaired and the day is absent rather than priced from a bridged two-day move.
